data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Polyester filling](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a23939ed65409c447e65fc2)
Hi, the colt was absolutely stunning but it’s a bummer to receive it after paying such a high dollar price for it and it’s filled with polyester. I think the item would be a lot better. If you left the polyester out a cotton linen blend is an incredible blanket without the filler. I absolutely love all of your items, but was disappointed in the blanket.

June 1, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 6, 2026

Hi Kaley,

Thank you for reaching out to us! At Lulu and Georgia, we only have the ability to offer what is posted on the website. If a particular specification of an item is not listed, it would not be possible to have it produced or sold with those changes. Please reach out to our Design Services Team so we can assist with your specific needs by clicking [here](https://fs7.formsite.com/2piFtI/mm9b9t77oa/index) and including the item you are looking for custom information on.

We sincerely apologize for the disappointment regarding the blanket's filling. Please let us know if you have any additional questions!
